title: API: sortBy quantity puts untracked last both ways; sortBy min then description; no sort lists tracked first
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-T1…T5, QAPL-N1…N5, QAPL-B1, QAPL-C1 (tracked) and QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 (untracked); search=QAPL- narrows the set. Load every page of each call the way the screen does (every order ends in the part id so pages join up). Known mismatch (don't file): the quantity sort uses the stored part quantity.
custom_steps:
1. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QAPL-&sortBy=quantity&descending=false.
  2. Send the same with descending=true.
  3. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QAPL-&sortBy=min&descending=false.
  4. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QAPL-&sortBy=&descending=false.
  5. Check every result for repeated or missing ids across pages.
custom_expected:
1. 200; tracked rows by quantity lowest first (equal quantities by description A–Z); every is_tracked false row (QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2) is in the tail, ordered by description A–Z.
  2. 200; tracked rows highest quantity first; the untracked rows are still the tail, A–Z by description.
  3. 200; rows ordered by Min ascending, then description A–Z; untracked rows are mixed in by their Min (tracking plays no part).
  4. 200; tracked rows first, A–Z by description, then the untracked rows, A–Z by description.
  5. No id appears twice and the row count equals the parts the search matches.
